Indian Athletes Train in Container Rooms for Asian Games Accommodation

Indian athletes are undergoing training in specially prepared container rooms in Patiala and Bengaluru to acclimatize to unusual accommodation arrangements for the upcoming Asian Games in Japan. Unlike previous games, there will not be a traditional athletes' village. Instead, athletes will be housed in containers, cruise ships, and other unconventional locations. The training aims to help athletes adapt to these conditions before the event.
